metadata.Name: X-RiSAWOZ
metadata.Description: A multi-domain, large-scale, and high-quality task-oriented dialogue benchmark, produced by translating the Chinese RiSAWOZ data to English, French, Hindi, Korean, and an English-Hindi code-mixed language. It is designed for training and evaluating end-to-end dialogue agents in zero- and few-shot settings.
metadata.Paper Title: Zero-Shot and Few-Shot Task-Oriented Dialogue with an End-to-End Agent and a New Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: We present a methodology and an associated toolkit for creating a multilingual task-oriented dialogue dataset by translating an existing high-quality dataset in another language. Our approach automates parts of the translation process and helps translators and annotators check their work, allowing for the fast and accurate creation of a new dialogue dataset. We apply our methodology to the Chinese RiSAWOZ dataset and create X-RiSAWOZ, a new multilingual dataset in English, French, Hindi, and Korean, as well as an English-Hindi code-mixed version. X-RiSAWOZ is a large-scale, high-quality dataset that can be used to train and evaluate end-to-end dialogue agents. We establish a new state-of-the-art on RiSAWOZ and show that our translated dataset can be used to train dialogue agents in the new languages in zero- and few-shot settings, achieving promising results. We are releasing our dataset, toolkit, and models to the community.
